title: First time on a Tuk Tuk
text: My first experience on a Tuk Tuk and the guide was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. For the amount of time we had, it was a quick perfect tour of the city and loved all of the information.
author: Amy_D

title: Great
text: Great tour. Very informative. Massimo was very nice and knowledgeable, took us to many places. Highly recommended
author: bianagodinv

title: Informative and fun
text: We found the whole tuk tuk tour was fabulous and very informative, it took us to areas and places that we wouldn’t have got to on foot in the heat  The driver was very helpful, knowledgeable, easy going and extremely friendly.
author: Deborah_T

title: Great way to familiarise...
text: Great way to familiarise yourself with the city, very competitively priced for a very full tour with friendly guides!
author: Nicholas_D

title: Fantastic tour with Emilio
text: What a fantastic 2 hour tour we had with Emilio. He was so enthusiastic about his home city of Seville and took us on a tour of all the little back roads making sure we saw all the main sites, in particular the Plaza d’Espana was fantastic. His knowledge of the history of Seville along with what it is like to live there today made this a very personal experience for us.  We would definitely recommend this tour to everyone.
author: Heather_R

author: liamkay

title: Great Tuk Tuk tour
text: We had the best tour guide with Carlos. He was funny and chitchatted with us the whole tour. He made sure to point out all the relevant sights as well as inserting the history behind it. Got to stop at Plaza de Espana, and walk around. We were on a time crunch so he made sure to keep the timeline efficient. Best, and quickest way to see Seville, and learn a little bit, in a more intimate setting.
author: Renee_S

title: Fun ride, great guide, poor acoustics
text: Booked our 2 hour tour of Seville for 10/16 at 11am. Our tour guide was wonderful - friendly, knowledgeable, and solicitous. He was on time, funny, and maneuvered around the narrow streets deftly. However, his microphone did not work and while he was able to get a replacement, it also didn’t work. He would stop here and there so we could hear him provide interesting facts about Seville but we would have appreciated being able to hear him throughout the tour.
